exemptions.@pr1/claim-id-unchanged: The claim_id FORM is a PLAN-0115 invariant this PR does not change; it is asserted here as the premise that tagging left it alone. Any mutation that moves it also moves the keys asserted above it in the same test, which redden first (the run stops at the first failed assert). Exempted on the s288 fixture-premise precedent rather than probed with a contrived mutation.
exemptions.@pr1/twin-control: Positive control for @pr1/twin-keeps-its-slot: it asserts the UNTAGGED copy of the same module still holds #0/2, which is what makes the assertion above it a statement about tagging rather than about the stamping changing. Every mutation that reddens it reddens the tagged assertion first, in the same test.
exemptions.@pr1/docstring-is-not-a-tag: Under 4e — the mutation this assertion's sibling is probed by — the docstring fixture raises ClaimTagError (an unattached tag inside the docstring), which the driver classifies CRASHED and refuses to credit (_outcome.py:462-468). The string-literal case is the assertion-level witness for the same tokenize-vs-regex claim; this one is its second fixture and is exempted with that reason, per AC-4.
exemptions.@pr1/h1-oracle: The closed-incident oracle: a four-line local reconstruction of the RETIRED (owner, prefix) rule, applied to the post-deletion fixture to show it would have resolved to the survivor. No mutation of the current code can redden it, because the rule it replays is no longer in the code — that is exactly what makes it an independent oracle rather than a second reading of the thing under test. Exempted on the PLAN-0115 AC-6 precedent.
exemptions.@pr1/lint-live-tag: Positive control for @pr1/lint-names-the-dead-tag: the SAME battery over the pre-deletion module reports nothing. Its reddening mutation is one that makes the lint over-report, which reddens test_a_healthy_battery_produces_no_findings in the s288 suite first — a module outside this battery's claim_sources, so a probe here could not credit it one-assertion-per-mutation.
exemptions.@pr1/shift-still-credited: Under 8a — the probe its sibling assertion is witnessed by — the verdict assertion above it reddens first and the run stops there. One mutation witnesses one assertion.
exemptions.@pr1/shift-is-not-a-misfire: The negative half of the same read, and it carries its positive control in the two assertions above it (PASS + witnessed RED: 1). Under 8a those redden first.
exemptions.@pr1/scenario-tag-credited: Under 8c the verdict assertion above it reddens first, in the same test.
exemptions.@pr1/transplant-both-red-is-a-misfire: PLAN-0128 §9 asked for the driver's classification of a hand-transplanted tag to be MEASURED and recorded, and explicitly closes no AC on the answer. This assertion records what the real driver printed; a mutation that changed it would be changing the measurement, not falsifying a claim the PR makes.
exemptions.@pr1/transplant-credited-at-new-site: Same as above: the recorded half of §9's measurement — the classifier IS fooled. It is the residual §2.3 states, written down as a fixture someone can run.
exemptions.@pr1/transplant-stranded-claim-is-a-gap: Same as above, and the more useful half: what refuses a transplant is the coverage denominator, not the site comparison. Recorded, not repaired.
